description: One GO / CAUTION / STOP status for a token: the Solana or Base token safety verdict, an OFAC sanctions screen of the token's mint/freeze authority or owner and of an optional counterparty wallet, and that wallet's pay-readiness (balances, canPay, shortfalls, approvals) for a USDC amount, with plain reasons. Combines those checks in one call. Heuristic, not an audit or legal advice. Read-only, never places orders. Informational only, not investment advice.

amount.description: USDC the wallet wants to pay (default 1; needs wallet)

chain.description: Token chain (default: detected from the address)

token.description: Solana mint (base58) or Base ERC-20 address (0x…), e.g. DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263 for BONK

wallet.description: Optional counterparty or paying wallet (Base 0x… or Solana base58)
